notes: Company profile: mid-market PLG SaaS providing B2B revenue workflow tools; heavy outbound sales org (120 SDRs + AEs).
Primary ask: replace brittle macros + Zapier flows with low-latency chat agents that can call CRM/email/calendar actions (create lead, send follow-up email, schedule meeting).
Workload shape: high concurrency during sales hours; expected 40-60 concurrent agent sessions during peak, 4k-8k unique end users/month.
Latency SLO: end-to-end streaming token latency target: median <100ms, 95th <350ms for interactive agent UI. Quote from Head of Product: "we need token-level streaming that feels realtime for reps".
Throughput target: sustain ~200 RPS of generation at 1-2k token responses, with KV-cache for short contexts; peak burst capacity required for campaign launches.
Model preference: started with open model family (LLaMA-derivative) for pricing; open to Redwood-verified variants. Also asked about quantized model options for Dedicated.
Routing/fallback needs: prefer hosted API for quick POC, but want an automatic fallback to cheaper quantized variant or regional fallback to maintain SLOs during load spikes.
Tooling: must support function/tool calling for CRM (Salesforce), Gmail/SendGrid, Google Calendar; require SDK examples and sample connectors.
Security/Compliance: Legal requires SOC2 attestation, SSO/SAML integration, audit logs for agent actions, customer data residency for EU accounts, KMS for key management.
POC plan: 4-week hosted API POC with staged acceptance criteria — week 1 integration + smoke, week 2 latency tuning + streaming UX, week 3 scale tests, week 4 user acceptance with 20 real reps.
Acceptance metrics proposed by SE: 95p token latency <= 350ms, average token cost target to meet $X per conversation (internal calc), no missed tool invocations in >99.5% of flows.
Pricing conversation: mid-market reserved pricing for Dedicated is attractive if POC proves latency/cost; finance wants clear unit economics vs self-host.
Technical notes from last call: implement prefix KV cache for repeated prompts, batched generation for background tasks, real-time stream for agent UI; need sample SDK streaming snippet.
Quote from CTO in meeting: "If hosted gives us reliable latency under load we'll convert to Dedicated reserve — but we need numbers not promises."
Internal AE notes: prioritize perf demo and hand off to procurement only after Legal answers on residency + KMS.
summary: AstraLoop is evaluating Redwood hosted API as a fast path POC for low-latency outbound sales chat agents that must perform tool calls (CRM/email/calendar) and stream token-by-token to rep UIs. If hosted POC meets latency and unit-cost targets, they will move to Dedicated reserved capacity. Procurement and Legal are the gating items (data residency + SOC2 + KMS). SE assigned for performance tuning.
